in_marathi.name: Hrishita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hrishita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hrishita is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'hrish' which means to possess, protect, and nourish. This name is given to a girl, symbolizing the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name is mentioned in the Hindu scripture Mahabharata, where it is used to describe the goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth and abundance. In Hindu mythology, Lakshmi is worshipped for her blessings of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune.
